Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning voter approval for use of banked levy capacity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voter approval for use of banked levy capacity;and reenacting and amending RCW 84.55.092.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.55.092 and 1998 c 16 s 3 are each reenacted andamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The regular property tax levy for each taxing district otherthan the state may be set at the amount which would be allowedotherwise under this chapter if the regular property tax levy for thedistrict for taxes due in prior years beginning with 1986 had been setat the full amount allowed under this chapter including any levyauthorized under RCW 52.16.160 that would have been imposed but for thelimitation in RCW 52.18.065, applicable upon imposition of the benefitcharge under chapter 52.18 RCW. (2) A taxing district is required to submit an authorizingproposition to the voters in order to increase the regular property taxlevy by an amount authorized under this section. The submittedproposition must be: (a) Approved by a majority of the voters of thetaxing district voting on the proposition; and (b) voted on at an p. 1 SB 6247election held not more than twelve months prior to the date in whichthe proposed regular property tax is to be levied. (3) The purpose of this section is to remove the incentive for ataxing district to maintain its tax levy at the maximum level permittedunder this chapter, and to protect the future levy capacity of a taxingdistrict that reduces its tax levy below the level that it otherwisecould impose under this chapter, by removing the adverse consequencesto future levy capacities resulting from such levy reductions.
